definitions.closure_year: Requests administratively closed during 2023, regardless of creation date.
definitions.creation_cohort_closed_by_cutoff: Requests created during 2023 and administratively closed by the 24 September 2026 cutoff.
definitions.creation_cohort_closed_by_year_end: Requests created and administratively closed during 2023.
definitions.simulator_as_implemented: FIFO replay with 2023 arrivals only and an empty queue on 1 January 2023.
definitions.simulator_exact_original: FIFO replay receiving only records created from 2022 onward, using closure opportunities from that restricted set, and starting with an empty queue on 1 January 2023.
definitions.simulator_one_year_warmup: FIFO replay receiving records created from 2022 onward, initialized with the subset still open on 1 January 2023.
definitions.simulator_with_initial_backlog: FIFO replay initialized with requests created before 2023 that were still open on 1 January 2023.
